lines.text: Nine oh three, in Lagos. Ada just got paid... by a client in New York.
No wire delays. No juggling five apps. Ray-nest is one place for her money, across currencies, and across borders.

She opens her U S D T wallet and shares her address. Her client sends on Solana, so it's fast, and low cost. And because U S D T is a stablecoin, every coin holds its value, one to one with the U S dollar.
At lunch, she tops up with Solana from her exchange. Ray-nest converts it to U S D C, right in her wallet. Bitcoin and Ethereum work the same way.
By evening, her savings go into the Stablecoin Vault, earning up to seven percent variable A P Y on U S D C and U S D T. Paid daily. Withdraw anytime.
Dinner is on her Ray-nest Visa card. Tap the physical card, or pay online with a virtual one, straight from her stablecoin balance. No converting first.
And when she needs her crypto somewhere else, she sends U S D C to an external wallet, on supported networks.
Get paid. Save. Spend. Send. All in one app. Sign up with my link on screen, and make your first transaction today.
